### 文件名显示 / File names

- **#62：聊天文件卡片加宽，长文件名中间省略、保留两端。** 根据实际可用宽度显示，空间允许时保留扩展名；组合字符和 emoji 不从中间拆开。
- 鼠标移到省略的文件名上立即浮出完整名称，移开即隐藏。浮层支持长名称换行、屏幕边缘避让和深浅色主题，不拦截按钮操作；滚动、调整窗口或切换会话时隐藏。键盘聚焦也可查看，Esc 可关闭。短名称直接显示完整内容。
- **#62: Wider chat file cards with middle-truncated long names, preserving both ends.** Names fit the available width, preserve the extension when space permits, and retain complete Unicode graphemes.
- Hover over a truncated name to immediately show its full name; move away to hide it. The popup wraps long names, stays within the viewport, follows the light/dark theme, and does not intercept file actions. Scrolling, resizing, or switching conversations dismisses it. Keyboard focus also opens it; Escape closes it. Short names remain fully visible.

### 验证 / Validation

- Linux 环境：135 个测试文件、978 项测试通过；Electron ABI 110 数据库自测、双端类型检查、生产构建、启动冒烟、版本及双语文档检查通过。
- 实际 Electron 22.3.27 / Xvfb：通过生产界面与鼠标输入验证悬停显隐、短名称、键盘聚焦/Esc、滚动及卸载清理、960×640 窗口下 100%/125% 缩放、超长英文名称浮层边界，以及深浅色主题。测试数据仅注入隔离会话，不访问真实局域网。
- Local Linux checks passed: 978 tests across 135 files, the Electron ABI 110 database self-test, both type checks, production build, startup smoke, version consistency, and documentation locale checks.
- Actual Electron 22.3.27 under Xvfb exercised the production UI with mouse input: hover visibility, short names, keyboard focus/Escape, scroll/unmount cleanup, a 960×640 window at 100%/125% zoom, long unbroken names within the viewport, and light/dark themes. Test fixtures used an isolated session and loopback-only networking.
